scope: Unauthenticated real HTTP/session/security boundary only; not proof of successful Argon2id login or authenticated browser workflows.

results.name: public page and local assets render with security headers
anonymous session issues private CSRF and HttpOnly SameSite cookie
wrong methods never perform state changes
missing CSRF is rejected before login processing
cross-site writes are rejected even with a valid CSRF token
non-JSON and malformed JSON fail with controlled errors
authenticated reads and mutations reject an anonymous client
failed login and activation do not disclose an account or stack trace
private directories, arbitrary PHP and traversal paths are not served
quick entry remains a same-origin CSRF-protected POST and cannot unlock private APIs
invalid query arrays and unknown action names are controlled
